taxonomic_note: Accepted by ITIS and Flora of North America; Texas is within the native range.
look_here_first: Ignore the flower at first and look underwater: submerged leaves are opposite and fan-shaped, split into many fine segments. When flowering, a small white-to-purplish 3-merous flower rises at the surface.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — peer-reviewed San Marcos River aquatic-plant survey lists Cabomba caroliniana as native. Travis — City of Austin Watershed Protection identifies fanwort as a native aquatic plant in Lady Bird Lake/Barton Springs system. Comal — Edwards Aquifer Habitat Conservation Plan / City of New Braunfels restoration program treats Cabomba caroliniana as native aquatic vegetation in the Comal/Landa Lake system.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Exact locality/county sources were used; no county inferred from statewide range.

best_field_traits: rooted submerged perennial with slender branched stems
submerged leaf blades fan-shaped and repeatedly dichotomously divided into fine segments
small floating leaves may appear near flowering shoots
solitary axillary flowers at or above the water surface
flowers 3-merous: three sepals and three petals
morphology_keys.habit: Rooted perennial submerged aquatic with much-branched slender stems.
morphology_keys.leaf_morphology: Strongly heterophyllous: the common submerged leaves are opposite, fan-shaped and finely divided; small linear floating leaves may be produced near flowering.
morphology_keys.flower: Solitary axillary 3-merous flower, generally white to purplish with yellow nectar-bearing auricles.
morphology_keys.fruit: Small fruits with one to three seeds.
morphology_keys.joey_field_note: Joey's San Marcos River frame gives a close flower view; combine it with the unmistakable opposite fan-shaped submerged foliage for identification.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Cabomba has opposite fan-shaped submerged leaves; Limnophila has finely divided leaves arranged in whorls. Cabomba also produces a distinctive small 3-merous surface flower.
